runs.text: Read the 9 numbers of a 3 × 3 grid, row by row, and show the sum of each row, one per line.

hints.text: How many sums do you have to show? How many numbers go into each one?
Keep the grid in a matrix, like the board in
For each row, the sum starts at 0 and gathers the three columns.
One loop over the rows; inside, the sum at 0 and a loop over the columns; at the end of each row, it is shown. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Also show the sum of each column.
Frequent mistake: setting the sum to 0 only once, before all the loops, which piles up the previous rows: 6, 21, 45.
